## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The header check in `app/report.py` is correct, and `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` would fail against the old prefix check, so it covers the new branch. The one Important item is `test_rejects_legacy_header`, which cannot fail for the version-check defect it says it guards.

## Changes
`parse_report` now accepts only the exact header `REPORT v1` instead of any line starting with `REPORT `. The pull request also adds two tests that check unsupported headers are rejected.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Make test_rejects_legacy_header reach the header check — Your `rsplit("v1", 1)` replaces the last `v1`, so the input becomes `"REPORT v1\nversion=v0"`. The header stays `v1` and there is no `END` line, so `parse_report` returns `None` at the `END` check (`app/report.py:3`) before it reaches the header check. The comment on line 9 says the test changes "the fixture's version to v0", but it changes the body line instead. — This test passes even if the version check is removed or broken, so it adds no regression protection for the change it names. — Fix: Use a complete fixture with a `v0` header, such as `"REPORT v0\nvalue=ok\nEND"`, or delete this test because `test_rejects_unsupported_header_with_complete_report` already covers that input.
